nodes.label: Local Dev Stack (dev.ps1)
nodes.rationale: azurite + Craft api container + module watcher + yarn frontend at localhost:5196; docker-compose.override.yml chained explicitly with -f because upstream's launcher would ignore it (explicit -f disables auto-merge)

nodes.label: Monorepo Knowledge Graph (graph.json)
nodes.rationale: check before grepping; AST nodes plus http_calls (frontend /api/X -> backend Invoke-X), bridge_calls (backend ps1 -> craft C# bridges), external_api nodes for microsoft endpoints; link-pass edges keep synthetic source_file tags because build_merge replace-on-re-extract would wipe real files' AST nodes

nodes.label: Graphify Scope Rules
nodes.rationale: never extract against cipp\ or craft\ directly, work from workspace root; !cipp and !craft lines in .graphifyignore are load-bearing since the workspace .gitignore excludes both clones and detect merges gitignores

nodes.label: graphifyy 0.9.12 Pin
nodes.rationale: pinned ==0.9.12 because spec\graphify-internals.md lists internals the toolkit depends on; re-verify before any bump
